title: One-step rightward head movement
statement: Let $P$ be a register program with $m$ work tapes, input $x$, oracle $O$, and register $r$. Suppose state $s$ is not a call state, and for every tuple of work-tape symbols its transition in state $s$, when the input symbol at position $q$ is read, moves the input head one position to the right, leaves all work-tape contents and head positions unchanged, emits no output, and enters state $s'$. For $q\le |x|$, any initial configuration with state $s$, input-head position $q$, and work-tape head $r$ at position $p$ reaches in one program step the same configuration data with state $s'$ and input-head position $q+1$.
hypotheses_covered: State $s$ is not a call state
For every work-symbol tuple, the transition at state $s$ on the input symbol at position $q$ is the specified rightward move with no work-tape changes or output and successor state $s'$
Initial input-head position is $q$ and register $r$'s work-tape head is at position $p$
